name: Ashish Kumar
title: Software Engineer
summary: Software Engineer with 2+ years of experience in backend development, cloud engineering, and AI-powered systems. Skilled in .NET, Azure services, API design, and microservices, with hands-on expertise in RAG workflows, LLM integrations, and enterprise bot development. Proven ability to improve system performance, reduce operational costs, and build scalable, production-grade solutions.

responsibilities: Developed and enhanced an enterprise AI-powered conversational platform integrating Microsoft Teams, Azure Bot Service, Copilot Studio, and .NET, enabling secure and scalable employee self-service experiences.

Designed and implemented Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows using Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, embeddings, and vector-based retrieval to ground LLM responses in enterprise knowledge and improve response relevance.
Built an enterprise D2E Relay Bot using ASP.NET Core/.NET, integrating Microsoft Teams with Copilot Studio and implementing On-Behalf-Of (OBO) authentication for secure user-context propagation.

Implemented real-time multilingual translation for user queries, Copilot responses, and Adaptive Cards using Azure AI Translator and Azure OpenAI/Foundry LLMs, including batching and content-protection mechanisms for reliable translation.
Developed proactive and bulk notification capabilities using Microsoft Graph API and Azure Cosmos DB, supporting message delivery to both existing and newly onboarded users.
Built OCR-based document processing pipelines using Azure Document Intelligence and integrated extracted data with LLM and RAG workflows for intelligent document understanding and question answering.
Implemented Adaptive Cards, Teams SSO, conversation state management, and proactive messaging, enabling interactive enterprise workflows and seamless agent-user experiences.
Optimized backend services using caching, asynchronous processing, batching, and API-level optimizations to improve scalability and reduce latency in AI and translation workflows.
Implemented MediatR to decouple business logic, reducing response times by 30%.
Managed 50+ APIs using Azure API Management with secure, scalable rollout.
Built serverless architectures with Azure Functions, lowering operational costs by 40%.
Implemented Azure AD & B2C authentication across 100+ enterprise apps.
Enabled JWT-based authorization aligned with enterprise security standards.

projects.name: Enterprise RAG-Based Document Q&A System
projects.description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation system for intelligent querying of enterprise documents, built on Azure AI Search.
highlights: Designed and implemented a RAG architecture using Azure AI Search to enable intelligent querying of enterprise documents.

Developed three independent pipelines: Document Indexing for uploading, processing, and indexing data; Question Answering for retrieving relevant information and generating contextual responses; and Index Deletion for removing indexed documents.
Leveraged Azure Logic Apps and Azure Functions to orchestrate workflows, automate pipeline execution, and handle backend processing.
Implemented backend functionality using Python, integrating document retrieval and search capabilities to support efficient information discovery.

achievements: Received Deloitte's "Move the Dot - Team" award for agentic AI solutions with Copilot Studio and Azure.
Ranked in the top 130 institutionally on GeeksforGeeks.
